question: What should the wise bestow in order from agama-beginning with dakshina?
premises: thus having done, in order-beginning agama-end, joined with dakshina
supporting betel-leaf cloth and the rest, the wise should bestow
inference: Orderly agama-beginning with dakshina delivers support-betel-cloth through the wise.
plain_english: Thus having done, in order-beginning agama-end, joined with dakshina — supporting betel-leaf cloth and the rest, the wise should bestow.
